"""Independent, structured whole-binary report.

The Report action no longer stitches together whatever other tabs happened to
leave in the history. It runs its own pipeline:

1. local, deterministic: overview -> code-origin index -> ranking -> verdict
   (``analysis/triage``, ``analysis/verdict``) - no model involved;
2. selection: the author functions that carry the most capability
   (``plan_sweep``), library/runtime/compiler code excluded;
3. per-function analysis of the decompiled author code, reusing every analysis
   already stored in the local database (``core/store``) and sending only the
   missing functions to the model;
4. one synthesis call (attack chain, IOCs), itself replayed from the local
   cache when nothing changed;
5. this module renders the structured Markdown report.

Everything here is pure Python; IDA access and model calls happen in the
controller. Findings are tagged ``[CONFIRMED]`` (observed, with an address),
``[INFERRED]`` or ``[HYPOTHESIS]``.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
from typing import Any, Dict, Iterable, List, Mapping, Optional, Sequence, Set, Tuple

from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis import behaviour as bh
from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.core.parsing import strip_json_fence
from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.llm.base import LLMRequest
from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.code_origin import ORIGIN_LABELS
from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.function import FunctionAnalysis
from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.sweep import (
    SweepCapability,
    SweepFunctionResult,
    SweepPlan,
    _batch_items,
)

REPORT_TITLE = "Static Analysis Report"
_BASIS_TAG = {"observed": "[CONFIRMED]", "inferred": "[INFERRED]", "hypothesis": "[HYPOTHESIS]"}

# Behaviour / capability category -> ATT&CK techniques (static mapping, shown as candidates).
ATTACK_BY_CATEGORY: Dict[str, Tuple[Tuple[str, str], ...]] = {
    bh.CREDENTIAL_THEFT: (("T1555.003", "Credentials from Web Browsers"), ("T1539", "Steal Web Session Cookie"), ("T1552.001", "Credentials in Files")),
    bh.KEYLOGGING: (("T1056.001", "Keylogging"), ("T1115", "Clipboard Data")),
    bh.SURVEILLANCE: (("T1113", "Screen Capture"), ("T1125", "Video Capture"), ("T1123", "Audio Capture")),
    bh.REMOTE_CONTROL: (("T1059.003", "Windows Command Shell"), ("T1090", "Proxy")),
    bh.C2: (("T1071.001", "Web Protocols"), ("T1041", "Exfiltration Over C2 Channel"), ("T1102", "Web Service")),
    bh.PERSISTENCE: (("T1547.001", "Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder"), ("T1053.005", "Scheduled Task")),
    bh.INJECTION: (("T1055", "Process Injection"), ("T1620", "Reflective Code Loading")),
    bh.EVASION: (("T1497", "Virtualization/Sandbox Evasion"), ("T1562.001", "Disable or Modify Tools"), ("T1070.004", "File Deletion")),
    bh.PRIVILEGE: (("T1548.002", "Bypass User Account Control"), ("T1134", "Access Token Manipulation")),
    bh.RANSOMWARE: (("T1486", "Data Encrypted for Impact"), ("T1490", "Inhibit System Recovery")),
    bh.DOWNLOAD_EXECUTE: (("T1105", "Ingress Tool Transfer"), ("T1204", "User Execution")),
    bh.CRYPTO_MINING: (("T1496", "Resource Hijacking"),),
    bh.HACKTOOL: (("T1059", "Command and Scripting Interpreter"), ("T1620", "Reflective Code Loading")),
    bh.PUP_BROWSER_HIJACK: (("T1176", "Browser Extensions"), ("T1185", "Browser Session Hijacking")),
    bh.PUP_ADWARE: (("T1176", "Browser Extensions"),),
    "injection": (("T1055", "Process Injection"),),
    "dynamic_resolution": (("T1027.007", "Dynamic API Resolution"),),
    "anti_debug": (("T1622", "Debugger Evasion"),),
    "anti_analysis": (("T1497", "Virtualization/Sandbox Evasion"),),
    "persistence": (("T1547.001", "Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder"), ("T1543.003", "Windows Service")),
    "network": (("T1071", "Application Layer Protocol"),),
    "crypto": (("T1027", "Obfuscated Files or Information"), ("T1140", "Deobfuscate/Decode Files or Information")),
    "packing": (("T1027.002", "Software Packing"),),
    "process_manipulation": (("T1055", "Process Injection"),),
    "networking": (("T1071", "Application Layer Protocol"),),
    "cryptography": (("T1027", "Obfuscated Files or Information"),),
    "execution": (("T1059", "Command and Scripting Interpreter"),),
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Persistence of per-function sweep results (local database payloads)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

STORE_KIND = "function_analysis"


def function_fingerprint(name: str, size: int, instruction_count: int) -> str:
    """Cheap identity of a function's current state: a rename or a size change re-analyses it."""
    return "{0}|{1}|{2}".format(name or "", int(size or 0), int(instruction_count or 0))


def sweep_function_to_payload(item: SweepFunctionResult) -> dict:
    analysis = item.analysis
    return {
        "address": item.address,
        "name": item.name,
        "level": item.level,
        "size": item.size,
        "analysis": {
            "summary": analysis.summary,
            "observed_behavior": list(analysis.observed_behavior),
            "inferences": list(analysis.inferences),
            "hypotheses": list(analysis.hypotheses),
            "important_apis": list(analysis.important_apis),
            "important_strings": list(analysis.important_strings),
            "related_functions": list(analysis.related_functions),
            "evidence": list(analysis.evidence),
            "behavior_confidence": analysis.behavior_confidence,
            "uncertainties": list(analysis.uncertainties),
            "suggested_name": analysis.suggested_name,
        },
        "capabilities": [
            {"category": cap.category, "capability": cap.capability, "evidence": list(cap.evidence), "confidence": cap.confidence, "basis": cap.basis}
            for cap in item.capabilities
        ],
        "indicators": [list(pair) for pair in item.indicators],
        "strings": list(item.strings)[:64],
        "callees": [[address, name] for address, name in item.callees][:64],
        "callers": [[address, name] for address, name in item.callers][:64],
    }


def payload_to_sweep_function(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Optional[SweepFunctionResult]:
    try:
        analysis_data = payload["analysis"]
        analysis = FunctionAnalysis(
            summary=str(analysis_data["summary"]),
            observed_behavior=tuple(str(item) for item in analysis_data.get("observed_behavior", ())),
            inferences=tuple(str(item) for item in analysis_data.get("inferences", ())),
            hypotheses=tuple(str(item) for item in analysis_data.get("hypotheses", ())),
            important_apis=tuple(str(item) for item in analysis_data.get("important_apis", ())),
            important_strings=tuple(str(item) for item in analysis_data.get("important_strings", ())),
            related_functions=tuple(str(item) for item in analysis_data.get("related_functions", ())),
            evidence=tuple(str(item) for item in analysis_data.get("evidence", ())),
            behavior_confidence=float(analysis_data.get("behavior_confidence", 0.0)),
            uncertainties=tuple(str(item) for item in analysis_data.get("uncertainties", ())),
            suggested_name=analysis_data.get("suggested_name") or None,
        )
        capabilities = tuple(
            SweepCapability(
                category=str(cap["category"]), capability=str(cap["capability"]), evidence=tuple(str(e) for e in cap.get("evidence", ())),
                confidence=float(cap.get("confidence", 0.0)), basis=str(cap.get("basis", "inferred")),
            )
            for cap in payload.get("capabilities", ())
        )
        return SweepFunctionResult(
            address=int(payload["address"]),
            name=str(payload["name"]),
            level=str(payload.get("level", "compact")),
            batch=0,
            analysis=analysis,
            capabilities=capabilities,
            indicators=tuple((str(pair[0]), str(pair[1])) for pair in payload.get("indicators", ()) if len(pair) == 2),
            strings=tuple(str(item) for item in payload.get("strings", ())),
            callees=tuple((int(pair[0]), str(pair[1])) for pair in payload.get("callees", ()) if len(pair) == 2),
            callers=tuple((int(pair[0]), str(pair[1])) for pair in payload.get("callers", ()) if len(pair) == 2),
            size=int(payload.get("size", 0) or 0),
        )
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
        return None


def without_items(plan: SweepPlan, skip: Set[int], system_tokens: int = 0) -> SweepPlan:
    """The same plan minus functions already analysed (re-batched), so only new work reaches the model."""
    items = tuple(item for item in plan.items if item.address not in skip)
    adjacency: Dict[int, Tuple[int, ...]] = {}
    for item in items:
        if item.parent is not None:
            adjacency.setdefault(item.parent, ())
            adjacency[item.parent] = adjacency[item.parent] + (item.address,)
    batches = _batch_items(list(items), adjacency, plan.batch_token_budget, system_tokens)
    return replace(plan, items=items, batches=tuple(batches))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Report rendering
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FullReportData:
    binary_name: str
    generated_at: float
    sample: Mapping[str, str]
    verdict: Any
    triage: Any = None
    packing: Any = None
    flows: Sequence[Any] = ()
    path: Sequence[Any] = ()
    origin_index: Any = None
    functions: Sequence[SweepFunctionResult] = ()
    investigation: Any = None
    analysed_new: int = 0
    reused: int = 0
    planned: int = 0
    tokens_used: int = 0
    uncertainties: Sequence[str] = ()
    analyst_notes: str = ""
    applied_changes: Sequence[str] = ()
    ai_summary: str = ""
    model_used: bool = True
    #: Whole-binary "what it does and why this verdict" paragraph (AI-written when available).
    justification: str = ""


MAX_REPORT_BYTES = 512 * 1024
REPORT_TRUNCATION_NOTE = "\n\n> Report truncated at the 512 KiB limit.\n"
# Characters that would let text taken from the sample (strings, names, model output) create
# links, images, HTML or code spans in a Markdown viewer.
_MARKDOWN_ESCAPES = {"\\": "\\\\", "`": "\\`", "[": "\\[", "]": "\\]", "<": "<", ">": ">", "*": "\\*", "_": "\\_", "#": "\\#"}


def _escape(text: str) -> str:
    return "".join(_MARKDOWN_ESCAPES.get(char, char) for char in text)


def _md(text: Any) -> str:
    """Single-line, Markdown-inert text for prose and list items (separators rendered as a middle dot)."""
    value = " ".join(str(text if text is not None else "").split())
    return _escape(value.replace(" | ", " · "))


def _code(text: Any) -> str:
    """Inline code span for names/addresses; backticks inside are neutralised."""
    value = " ".join(str(text if text is not None else "").split()).replace("`", "'")
    return "`{0}`".format(value) if value else ""


def cap_report(markdown: str, limit: int = MAX_REPORT_BYTES) -> str:
    encoded = markdown.encode("utf-8")
    if len(encoded) <= limit:
        return markdown
    budget = limit - len(REPORT_TRUNCATION_NOTE.encode("utf-8"))
    return encoded[:budget].decode("utf-8", "ignore") + REPORT_TRUNCATION_NOTE


def _cell(text: Any) -> str:
    """Table-cell text: additionally escapes the column separator."""
    return _md(text).replace("|", "\\|")


def _hex(value: Any) -> str:
    return "0x{0:X}".format(value) if isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool) else str(value or "")


def _table(headers: Sequence[str], rows: Iterable[Sequence[Any]]) -> List[str]:
    lines = ["| " + " | ".join(headers) + " |", "|" + "|".join("---" for _ in headers) + "|"]
    for row in rows:
        lines.append("| " + " | ".join(_cell(cell) for cell in row) + " |")
    return lines


def _first_sentence(text: str, limit: int = 140) -> str:
    value = " ".join((text or "").split())
    for stop in (". ", "; "):
        if stop in value[: limit + 2]:
            value = value[: value.index(stop) + 1]
            break
    return value if len(value) <= limit else value[: limit - 1] + "…"


def generate_full_report(data: FullReportData) -> str:
    verdict = data.verdict
    lines: List[str] = []
    lines.append("# {0} — {1}".format(REPORT_TITLE, _md(data.binary_name)))
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("> Static analysis only: the sample was not executed. Generated {0} by IDA AI Malware Analyst. "
                 "Findings are tagged [CONFIRMED] (observed, with address), [INFERRED] or [HYPOTHESIS].".format(
                     time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC", time.gmtime(data.generated_at))))
    lines.append("")

    # 1. Verdict --------------------------------------------------------------
    lines += ["## 1. Verdict", ""]
    classification = getattr(verdict, "classification", "") or "UNDETERMINED"
    subtype = getattr(verdict, "subtype", "")
    lines += _table(
        ("Classification", "Subtype", "Confidence", "Local score", "Band"),
        [(classification, subtype or "—", "{0}%".format(getattr(verdict, "confidence", 0)), "{0}/100".format(verdict.score), verdict.band.label)],
    )
    lines.append("")
    # Whole-binary functionality and the reason for this classification - never a single
    # function's description (the synthesis summary falls back to one when no model ran).
    lines.append("**Summary and justification.** " + _md(data.justification.strip() or local_justification(data)))
    lines.append("")

    # 2. Metadata -------------------------------------------------------------
    lines += ["## 2. Sample Metadata", ""]
    sample_rows = [(key, value) for key, value in data.sample.items()]
    sample_rows.append(("Language / toolchain", getattr(verdict, "language", "unknown")))
    sample_rows.append(("Functions (total / author)", "{0} / {1}".format(getattr(verdict, "total_function_count", 0), getattr(verdict, "author_function_count", 0))))
    lines += _table(("Field", "Value"), sample_rows)
    lines.append("")

    # 3. Code origin ----------------------------------------------------------
    lines += ["## 3. Code Origin (compiler and library code filtered)", ""]
    index = data.origin_index
    if index is not None:
        rows = [(ORIGIN_LABELS.get(origin, origin), count, "{0:.1%}".format(count / float(index.total)) if index.total else "-")
                for origin, count in index.counts if count]
        lines += _table(("Origin", "Functions", "Share"), rows)
        lines.append("")
        if index.third_party_libraries:
            lines.append("Third-party libraries: " + ", ".join("{0} ({1})".format(_code(name), count) for name, count in index.third_party_libraries[:20]))
            lines.append("")
        if index.language.evidence:
            lines.append("Toolchain evidence: " + "; ".join(index.language.evidence))
            lines.append("")
        lines.append("Only author code (and unclassified code) was ranked, sent for analysis and used for behaviour evidence.")
    else:
        lines.append("_Code-origin index unavailable._")
    lines.append("")

    # 4. Ranked findings ------------------------------------------------------
    lines += ["## 4. Ranked Findings", ""]
    findings = _ranked_findings(data)
    if findings:
        for number, text in enumerate(findings, 1):
            lines.append("{0}. {1}".format(number, text))
    else:
        lines.append("_No capability findings. Absence of evidence is not proof of benign behaviour._")
    lines.append("")

    # 5. Author functions -----------------------------------------------------
    lines += ["## 5. Key Author Functions", ""]
    if data.functions:
        rows = []
        for item in sorted(data.functions, key=lambda entry: (-_function_weight(entry), entry.address))[:40]:
            caps = ", ".join(dict.fromkeys(cap.category for cap in item.capabilities)) or "—"
            rows.append((_hex(item.address), item.name, _first_sentence(item.analysis.summary), caps, item.analysis.confidence_label))
        lines += _table(("Address", "Function", "Role", "Capabilities", "Confidence"), rows)
    else:
        lines.append("_No author functions were analysed (no AI provider configured, or nothing exceeded the interest threshold)._")
    lines.append("")

    # 6. Execution flow -------------------------------------------------------
    lines += ["## 6. Execution Flow", ""]
    # The synthesis summary describes the attack chain; show it only when a chain was produced.
    chain_summary = (data.ai_summary or "").strip() if tuple(getattr(data.investigation, "chain", ()) or ()) else ""
    if chain_summary:
        lines += [_md(chain_summary), ""]
    lines += _execution_flow(data)
    lines.append("")

    # 7. IOCs -----------------------------------------------------------------
    lines += ["## 7. Indicators of Compromise (defanged)", ""]
    iocs = _iocs(data)
    if iocs:
        lines += _table(("Type", "Value", "Source"), iocs)
    else:
        lines.append("_No indicators recovered statically (they may be encrypted or built at run time)._")
    lines.append("")

    # 8. ATT&CK ---------------------------------------------------------------
    lines += ["## 8. MITRE ATT&CK (candidate mapping)", ""]
    techniques = _techniques(data)
    if techniques:
        lines += _table(("Technique", "Name", "Basis"), techniques)
    else:
        lines.append("_No techniques mapped._")
    lines.append("")

    # 9. Packing / obfuscation ------------------------------------------------
    lines += ["## 9. Packing and Obfuscation", ""]
    packing_lines = list(getattr(verdict, "packing_indicators", ()) or ())
    likelihood = getattr(data.packing, "packed_likelihood", None)
    if likelihood is not None:
        lines.append("Packed likelihood: **{0}**".format(likelihood))
    lines += ["- " + _md(item) for item in packing_lines] or ["- No packing indicators."]
    lines.append("")

    # 10. Alternatives --------------------------------------------------------
    lines += ["## 10. Alternative Hypotheses", ""]
    lines += ["- " + item for item in _alternatives(verdict)]
    lines.append("")

    # 11. Limitations ---------------------------------------------------------
    lines += ["## 11. Limitations", ""]
    limitations = list(getattr(verdict, "notes", ()) or ())
    limitations += list(data.uncertainties)[:15]
    if not data.model_used:
        limitations.append("No AI provider was available: function behaviour comes from names, strings, imports and libraries only.")
    if data.planned and data.analysed_new + data.reused < data.planned:
        limitations.append("{0} of {1} selected functions were analysed (budget or cancellation).".format(data.analysed_new + data.reused, data.planned))
    lines += ["- " + _md(item) for item in dict.fromkeys(limitations)] or ["- None recorded."]
    lines.append("")

    # 12. Next steps ----------------------------------------------------------
    lines += ["## 12. Recommended Next Steps", ""]
    lines += ["- " + item for item in _next_steps(data)]
    lines.append("")

    # 13. Coverage ------------------------------------------------------------
    lines += ["## 13. Analysis Coverage", ""]
    lines += _table(
        ("Metric", "Value"),
        [
            ("Author functions selected", data.planned),
            ("Analysed now (model)", data.analysed_new),
            ("Reused from local database (0 tokens)", data.reused),
            ("Tokens used for this report", data.tokens_used),
        ],
    )
    if data.applied_changes:
        lines += ["", "Analyst-approved changes in this IDB:"] + ["- " + _md(item) for item in data.applied_changes[:30]]
    if data.analyst_notes.strip():
        lines += ["", "### Analyst Notes", "", data.analyst_notes.strip()]
    lines.append("")
    return cap_report("\n".join(lines))


def _function_weight(item: SweepFunctionResult) -> float:
    strong = sum(1 for cap in item.capabilities if cap.basis == "observed")
    return strong * 2 + len(item.capabilities) + item.analysis.behavior_confidence


def _local_summary(data: FullReportData) -> str:
    verdict = data.verdict
    behaviours = [item for item in verdict.evidence if item.category.startswith("behaviour:")]
    parts = []
    if verdict.classification == "MALWARE":
        parts.append("The sample is assessed as **malicious ({0})**.".format(verdict.subtype or "generic"))
    elif verdict.classification == "PUP/PUA":
        parts.append("The sample is assessed as a **potentially unwanted program ({0})**.".format(verdict.subtype))
    elif verdict.classification == "LEGITIMATE":
        parts.append("No malicious behaviour was found in the author code; the sample is assessed as **legitimate**.")
    else:
        parts.append("The evidence is **inconclusive**.")
    if behaviours:
        parts.append("Main behaviours: " + "; ".join(item.description.split(":", 1)[0] for item in behaviours[:5]) + ".")
    if data.functions:
        top = sorted(data.functions, key=lambda entry: -_function_weight(entry))[:3]
        parts.append("Most relevant author functions: " + ", ".join("{0} ({1})".format(_code(item.name), _hex(item.address)) for item in top) + ".")
    return " ".join(parts)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Verdict justification: whole-binary functionality and why this classification
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

JUSTIFICATION_MAX_CHARS = 1400
JUSTIFICATION_MAX_FUNCTIONS = 15


def _clip(text: Any, limit: int) -> str:
    value = " ".join(str(text if text is not None else "").split())
    return value if len(value) <= limit else value[: limit - 1] + "…"


def _evidence_text(item: Any) -> str:
    where = " at " + ", ".join(item.addresses[:2]) if getattr(item, "addresses", ()) else ""
    return _clip(item.description, 160) + where


def justification_facts(data: FullReportData) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Bounded, JSON-ready facts for the justification call (no code, nothing new from IDA)."""
    verdict = data.verdict
    index = data.origin_index
    functions = sorted(data.functions, key=lambda entry: (-_function_weight(entry), entry.address))[:JUSTIFICATION_MAX_FUNCTIONS]
    evidence = [
        {"weight": item.weight, "category": item.category, "description": _clip(item.description, 240),
         "addresses": list(item.addresses[:4]), "basis": item.basis}
        for item in tuple(verdict.evidence) + tuple(getattr(verdict, "mitigating", ()) or ())
    ][:30]
    chain = tuple(getattr(data.investigation, "chain", ()) or ())
    return {
        "verdict": {
            "classification": getattr(verdict, "classification", "") or "UNDETERMINED",
            "subtype": getattr(verdict, "subtype", ""),
            "confidence_percent": getattr(verdict, "confidence", 0),
            "local_score": verdict.score,
            "band": verdict.band.label,
            "family_hints": list(getattr(verdict, "family_hints", ()) or ())[:5],
        },
        "sample": {key: _clip(value, 200) for key, value in data.sample.items()},
        "language": getattr(verdict, "language", "unknown"),
        "functions": {"total": getattr(verdict, "total_function_count", 0), "author": getattr(verdict, "author_function_count", 0)},
        "code_origin": (
            {"counts": {origin: count for origin, count in index.counts if count},
             "third_party_libraries": [name for name, _count in index.third_party_libraries[:12]]}
            if index is not None else None
        ),
        "evidence": evidence,
        "packing_indicators": [_clip(item, 160) for item in tuple(getattr(verdict, "packing_indicators", ()) or ())[:6]],
        "author_functions": [
            {"address": _hex(item.address), "name": item.name, "summary": _clip(item.analysis.summary, 320),
             "capabilities": ["{0}: {1} ({2})".format(cap.category, _clip(cap.capability, 80), cap.basis) for cap in item.capabilities[:6]]}
            for item in functions
        ],
        "attack_chain": [{"stage": step.stage, "description": _clip(step.description, 200), "basis": getattr(step, "basis", "")}
                         for step in chain[:8]],
    }


def build_justification_request(data: FullReportData, system_prompt: str, max_output_tokens: int = 1024,
                                temperature: float = 0.2) -> LLMRequest:
    return LLMRequest(
        prompt=json.dumps({"facts": justification_facts(data)}, ensure_ascii=False),
        system_instruction=system_prompt,
        max_output_tokens=max(512, min(int(max_output_tokens or 1024), 2048)),
        temperature=temperature,
        response_mime_type="application/json",
    )


def parse_justification(text: str) -> str:
    """The paragraph from ``{"justification": "..."}``; raises ``ValueError`` on anything else."""
    value = json.loads(strip_json_fence(text))
    paragraph = value.get("justification") if isinstance(value, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(paragraph, str) or not paragraph.strip():
        raise ValueError("justification response did not contain a paragraph")
    return _clip(paragraph, JUSTIFICATION_MAX_CHARS)


def generate_justification(data: FullReportData, provider: Any, system_prompt: str, max_output_tokens: int = 1024,
                           temperature: float = 0.2) -> str:
    """One small model call; the caller falls back to ``local_justification`` on any failure."""
    response = provider.generate(build_justification_request(data, system_prompt, max_output_tokens, temperature))
    return parse_justification(response.text)


def local_justification(data: FullReportData) -> str:
    """Deterministic whole-binary paragraph from the same facts (used when no model is available)."""
    verdict = data.verdict
    classification = getattr(verdict, "classification", "") or "UNDETERMINED"
    subtype = getattr(verdict, "subtype", "")
    language = getattr(verdict, "language", "unknown")
    total = getattr(verdict, "total_function_count", 0)
    author = getattr(verdict, "author_function_count", 0)
    functions = sorted(data.functions, key=lambda entry: (-_function_weight(entry), entry.address))
    # Describe the binary through functions that actually carry capability; capability-less
    # helpers (entry stubs, runtime trampolines) only when nothing else was analysed.
    functions = [item for item in functions if item.capabilities] or functions
    parts: List[str] = []

    # What the binary does as a whole.
    pretty = {"go": "Go", "rust": "Rust", "delphi": "Delphi", "nim": "Nim", "dotnet": ".NET", ".net": ".NET",
              "c/c++": "C/C++", "cpp": "C/C++", "c": "C"}.get(str(language).lower(), language)
    subject = "This {0} binary".format(pretty) if language and language != "unknown" else "This binary"
    size = " ({0} of {1} functions are author code; the rest is runtime, library or compiler code)".format(author, total) if total else ""
    roles = [_first_sentence(item.analysis.summary, 160).rstrip(".") for item in functions[:3] if item.analysis.summary.strip()]
    capabilities = list(dict.fromkeys(
        cap.capability for item in functions for cap in item.capabilities if cap.basis in ("observed", "inferred")
    ))[:6]
    behaviours = [item.description.split(":", 1)[0] for item in verdict.evidence if item.category.startswith("behaviour:")][:4]
    if roles:
        parts.append("{0}{1}: {2}.".format(subject, size, "; ".join(
            "{0} ({1})".format(role, _hex(item.address)) for role, item in zip(roles, functions[:3]))))
    else:
        parts.append("{0}{1} was assessed from local static evidence only; no author function was analysed by the model.".format(subject, size))
    if capabilities:
        parts.append("Capabilities identified in the author code: {0}.".format(", ".join(capabilities)))
    elif behaviours:
        parts.append("Behaviour indicators: {0}.".format(", ".join(behaviours)))

    # Why this classification.
    positives = sorted((item for item in verdict.evidence if item.weight > 0), key=lambda item: -item.weight)[:3]
    benign = [item for item in tuple(verdict.evidence) + tuple(getattr(verdict, "mitigating", ()) or ()) if item.weight < 0][:2]
    score = "local score {0}/100, confidence {1}%".format(verdict.score, getattr(verdict, "confidence", 0))
    if classification == "MALWARE":
        parts.append("It is classified as malware{0} ({1}) because of {2}.".format(
            " ({0})".format(subtype) if subtype else "", score,
            "; ".join(_evidence_text(item) for item in positives) or "the corroborated behaviour evidence"))
    elif classification == "PUP/PUA":
        parts.append("It is classified as a potentially unwanted program{0} ({1}) because of {2}; no credential theft, remote "
                     "control or code injection was corroborated.".format(
                         " ({0})".format(subtype) if subtype else "", score,
                         "; ".join(_evidence_text(item) for item in positives) or "its unwanted-behaviour indicators"))
    elif classification == "LEGITIMATE":
        weak = (" The only suspicious signals were weak or uncorroborated: {0}.".format("; ".join(_evidence_text(item) for item in positives))
                if positives else "")
        parts.append("It is classified as legitimate ({0}): no corroborated malicious capability (credential theft, remote "
                     "control, injection, persistence, ransomware or covert C2) was found in the author code.{1}".format(score, weak))
    else:
        parts.append("The verdict is inconclusive ({0}): {1}.".format(
            score, "; ".join(_evidence_text(item) for item in positives) or "the evidence is insufficient either way"))
    if benign:
        parts.append("Benign signals: {0}.".format("; ".join(_evidence_text(item) for item in benign)))
    if getattr(verdict, "packing_indicators", ()):
        parts.append("Packing or obfuscation limits what static analysis can see, so dynamic analysis is recommended.")
    return " ".join(parts)


def _ranked_findings(data: FullReportData) -> List[str]:
    verdict = data.verdict
    entries: List[Tuple[int, str]] = []
    for item in verdict.evidence:
        tag = "[CONFIRMED]" if item.basis == "observed" and item.addresses else ("[INFERRED]" if item.basis != "hypothesis" else "[HYPOTHESIS]")
        where = " — " + ", ".join(item.addresses) if item.addresses else ""
        entries.append((item.weight * 10, "{0} {1}{2} (+{3})".format(tag, _md(item.description), where, item.weight)))
    seen: Set[Tuple[str, str]] = set()
    for function in data.functions:
        for cap in function.capabilities:
            key = (cap.category, cap.capability)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            tag = _BASIS_TAG.get(cap.basis, "[INFERRED]")
            evidence = "; ".join(cap.evidence[:2])
            entries.append((int(cap.confidence * 100), "{0} {1}: {2} — {3} {4}{5}".format(
                tag, _md(cap.category), _md(cap.capability), _code(function.name), _hex(function.address),
                " ({0})".format(_md(evidence)) if evidence else "",
            )))
    entries.sort(key=lambda pair: -pair[0])
    return [text for _weight, text in entries[:30]]


def _execution_flow(data: FullReportData) -> List[str]:
    investigation = data.investigation
    chain = tuple(getattr(investigation, "chain", ()) or ())
    if chain:
        output = []
        for step in chain:
            where = " — {0} {1}".format(_code(step.function_name), _hex(step.function_address)) if step.function_address is not None else ""
            tag = _BASIS_TAG.get(getattr(step, "basis", "inferred"), "[INFERRED]")
            output.append("{0}. **{1}** {2} {3}{4}".format(step.order, _md(step.stage), tag, _md(step.description), where))
        return output
    if data.path:
        return ["{0}. {1} {2} — {3}".format(step.order, _code(step.name), _hex(step.address), _md(step.why)) for step in data.path[:12]]
    return ["_No execution flow could be reconstructed._"]


def _iocs(data: FullReportData) -> List[Tuple[str, str, str]]:
    rows: List[Tuple[str, str, str]] = []
    seen: Set[str] = set()
    for indicator in tuple(getattr(data.investigation, "indicators", ()) or ()):
        key = indicator.kind + ":" + indicator.value
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        rows.append((indicator.kind, indicator.defanged, _hex(indicator.source_address) if indicator.source_address is not None else indicator.source))
    for item in data.verdict.evidence:
        if item.category != "strings" or not item.description.startswith(("URL", "named pipe")):
            continue
        for chunk in item.description.split('"')[1::2]:
            defanged = chunk.replace("http", "hxxp").replace(".", "[.]")
            if chunk not in seen:
                seen.add(chunk)
                rows.append(("string", defanged, ", ".join(item.addresses) or "strings"))
    return rows[:60]


def _techniques(data: FullReportData) -> List[Tuple[str, str, str]]:
    rows: Dict[str, Tuple[str, str, str]] = {}
    for step in tuple(getattr(data.investigation, "chain", ()) or ()):
        technique = getattr(step, "mitre_technique", None)
        if technique:
            rows.setdefault(technique.split()[0], (technique.split()[0], _md(step.stage), "attack chain [{0}]".format(step.basis)))
    categories: List[str] = []
    for item in data.verdict.evidence:
        categories.append(item.category.split(":", 1)[-1])
    for function in data.functions:
        categories.extend(cap.category for cap in function.capabilities if cap.basis == "observed")
    for category in categories:
        for technique, name in ATTACK_BY_CATEGORY.get(category, ()):
            rows.setdefault(technique, (technique, name, "category: " + category))
    return sorted(rows.values())


def _alternatives(verdict: Any) -> List[str]:
    classification = getattr(verdict, "classification", "")
    subtype = getattr(verdict, "subtype", "")
    if classification == "MALWARE":
        output = ["Legitimate software with overlapping features (admin, backup, remote-support or security tool) — rejected only if the "
                  "behaviours above are hidden from the user, persist without consent, or exfiltrate data."]
        if "Hacktool" in subtype:
            output.append("Authorised red-team / penetration-test build — possible; treat as malicious unless an engagement owns the infrastructure.")
        if "RAT" in subtype or "Backdoor" in subtype:
            output.append("Commercial remote-administration tool — check for signer, installer, consent UI and documented vendor.")
        return output
    if classification == "PUP/PUA":
        return ["Legitimate browser extension / utility installer — rejected if settings are changed without consent or tamper checks are forged.",
                "Full malware — would require credential theft, remote control or code injection, none of which was corroborated."]
    if classification == "LEGITIMATE":
        return ["Packed, encrypted or downloaded payload invisible to static analysis — check the packing section and run dynamic analysis if in doubt.",
                "Trojanised build of legitimate software — compare section hashes against the vendor release."]
    return ["Evidence is insufficient either way; obtain companion files (configs, payloads) or run dynamic analysis."]


def _next_steps(data: FullReportData) -> List[str]:
    steps = []
    verdict = data.verdict
    if getattr(verdict, "packing_indicators", ()):
        steps.append("Unpack or dump the sample after its loader runs, then re-run the report on the unpacked image.")
    if verdict.classification in ("MALWARE", "SUSPICIOUS-INCONCLUSIVE"):
        steps.append("Dynamic analysis in an isolated VM with a network sink: capture C2 traffic, dropped files, persistence artefacts and child processes.")
        steps.append("Extract and decrypt the configuration statically from the decoder functions listed in section 5.")
    if data.origin_index is not None and data.origin_index.named_author_count == 0:
        steps.append("Recover symbols (Go pclntab / Rust / Delphi RTTI) or apply FLIRT/Lumina signatures, then re-run so author code can be separated by name.")
    steps.append("Review the functions in section 5 in the decompiler and approve or reject the pending name proposals.")
    return steps

160	    """The same plan minus functions already analysed (re-batched), so only new work reaches the model."""

213	def _md(text: Any) -> str:
214	    """Single-line, Markdown-inert text for prose and list items (separators rendered as a middle dot)."""

226	    encoded = markdown.encode("utf-8")
227	    if len(encoded) <= limit:

229	    budget = limit - len(REPORT_TRUNCATION_NOTE.encode("utf-8"))

243	    lines = ["| " + " | ".join(headers) + " |", "|" + "|".join("---" for _ in headers) + "|"]

253	            value = value[: value.index(stop) + 1]

"""Shared, dependency-free helpers for recovering JSON from model output."""

from __future__ import annotations


def strip_json_fence(raw: str) -> str:
    """Remove a surrounding Markdown code fence (```json ... ```) if present.

    The helper never raises; a non-string input becomes an empty string so
    callers can report a single, consistent "malformed" error.
    """
    if not isinstance(raw, str):
        return ""
    candidate = raw.strip()
    if candidate.startswith("```"):
        candidate = candidate.split("\n", 1)[1] if "\n" in candidate else ""
        candidate = candidate.strip()
        if candidate.endswith("```"):
            candidate = candidate[:-3].strip()
    return candidate

2	
3	Pure Python. The controller builds a ``BinaryTriageOutcome`` from the
4	overview (which is then discarded) and keeps a small ``SweepSeed`` so the
5	"Investigate top N" sweep can plan without touching IDA again.
6	"""

19

21	@dataclass(frozen=True)
22	class SweepSeed:
23	    """Compact, IDA-free facts the binary sweep needs (kept after the overview is dropped)."""
24	
25	    ranked: Tuple[FunctionScore, ...]
26	    flows: Tuple[CallFlow, ...]

28	    band: VerdictBand

77	def format_binary_triage(outcome: BinaryTriageOutcome) -> str:
78	    """Concise Triage tab text; each fact appears once.
79	
80	    Verdict (classification, evidence, code origin), a one-line packing
81	    headline, the top author functions and the strongest call flows. The
82	    full analysis path lives in the jump list below the text, the complete
83	    write-up in the Report tab.
84	    """
85	    parts: List[str] = [format_verdict(outcome.verdict).rstrip()]
86	    if outcome.changes:

"""The Analyze Binary result bundle: triage report, verdict, packing, call flows and analysis path.

Pure Python. The controller builds a ``BinaryTriageOutcome`` from the
overview (which is then discarded) and keeps a small ``SweepSeed`` so the
"Investigate top N" sweep can plan without touching IDA again.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, FrozenSet, List, Mapping, Optional, Sequence, Tuple

from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.callflow import AnalysisStep, CallFlow
from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.packing import PackingAssessment
from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.pe_static import format_static_facts
from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.code_signals import format_code_signals
from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.triage import FunctionScore, TriageReport, triage_jump_targets
from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.verdict import Verdict, VerdictBand, format_verdict


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SweepSeed:
    """Compact, IDA-free facts the binary sweep needs (kept after the overview is dropped)."""

    ranked: Tuple[FunctionScore, ...]
    flows: Tuple[CallFlow, ...]
    path: Tuple[AnalysisStep, ...]
    band: VerdictBand
    score: int
    noise: FrozenSet[int]
    adjacency: Mapping[int, Tuple[int, ...]]
    names: Mapping[int, str]
    instruction_counts: Mapping[int, int]
    entries: Tuple[int, ...]
    evidence_categories: FrozenSet[str] = frozenset()
    packing: Optional[PackingAssessment] = None
    # Compact all-function inventory retained only for the one-click binary
    # function-naming workflow; no assembly or pseudocode is kept here.
    functions: Tuple[Any, ...] = ()
    functions_truncated: bool = False


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class BinaryTriageOutcome:
    report: TriageReport
    verdict: Verdict
    packing: Optional[PackingAssessment]
    flows: Tuple[CallFlow, ...]
    path: Tuple[AnalysisStep, ...]
    #: PE-file facts (``analysis/pe_static.PeFacts``) and their findings; ``None`` / ``()`` when unavailable.
    pe: Any = None
    static_findings: Tuple[Any, ...] = ()
    #: Strings recovered from Go/Rust/Nim literal references (count shown in the Triage tab).
    recovered_literals: int = 0
    #: ``analysis/code_signals.CodeSignals`` of the author code, when collected.
    code_signals: Any = None
    #: What changed since the previous triage of the same file in this IDA session.
    changes: Tuple[str, ...] = ()

    @property
    def high_interest(self):  # compatibility with code that read the TriageReport directly
        return self.report.high_interest

    @property
    def suspicious_imports(self):
        return self.report.suspicious_imports

    @property
    def ai_summary(self) -> Optional[str]:
        return self.report.ai_summary


TRIAGE_TAB_FUNCTIONS = 10
TRIAGE_TAB_FLOWS = 5


def format_binary_triage(outcome: BinaryTriageOutcome) -> str:
    """Concise Triage tab text; each fact appears once.

    Verdict (classification, evidence, code origin), a one-line packing
    headline, the top author functions and the strongest call flows. The
    full analysis path lives in the jump list below the text, the complete
    write-up in the Report tab.
    """
    parts: List[str] = [format_verdict(outcome.verdict).rstrip()]
    if outcome.changes:
        parts.append("Changes since the previous triage in this session:\n" + "\n".join("  " + line for line in outcome.changes))
    parts.append(format_static_facts(outcome.pe, outcome.static_findings))
    code_block = format_code_signals(outcome.code_signals)
    if code_block:
        parts.append(code_block)
    if outcome.recovered_literals:
        parts.append("Recovered {0} string literal(s) referenced by author code (Go/Rust/Nim literals IDA's string list misses).".format(
            outcome.recovered_literals))
    packing = outcome.packing
    if packing is not None:
        likelihood = getattr(packing, "packed_likelihood", None)
        indicators = tuple(getattr(packing, "indicators", ()) or ())
        line = "Packing: {0}".format(likelihood if likelihood is not None else "n/a")
        if indicators:
            line += " — " + "; ".join(str(getattr(item, "detail", "") or getattr(item, "name", item)) for item in indicators[:3])
        packers = tuple(getattr(packing, "packers", ()) or ())
        if packers:
            line += " (packer: {0})".format(", ".join(packers[:3]))
        parts.append(line)
    top = tuple(outcome.report.high_interest[:TRIAGE_TAB_FUNCTIONS])
    if top:
        lines = ["Top author functions (double-click in the list below to jump):"]
        for item in top:
            reasons = "; ".join(item.reasons[:2])
            lines.append("  0x{0:X}  {1:<36} score {2:>3}  {3}".format(item.address, item.name[:36], item.score, reasons))
        parts.append("\n".join(lines))
    else:
        parts.append("Top author functions: none scored above zero.")
    flows = tuple(outcome.flows[:TRIAGE_TAB_FLOWS])
    if flows:
        lines = ["Suspicious call flows:"]
        for flow in flows:
            chain = " → ".join(name for _address, name in (flow.path or ((flow.target, flow.target_name),)))
            lines.append("  {0}  ({1})".format(chain, flow.reasons[0] if flow.reasons else flow.note or ""))
        parts.append("\n".join(lines))
    return "\n\n".join(part for part in parts if part) + "\n"


def binary_triage_jump_targets(outcome: BinaryTriageOutcome) -> Tuple[Tuple[int, str, str], ...]:
    """``(address, name, role)`` in display order, de-duplicated.

    Verdict evidence addresses first (every "Why" line becomes clickable), then
    functions with deterministic code signals, the analysis path and the ranking.
    """
    seen = set()
    targets: List[Tuple[int, str, str]] = []
    names = {item.address: item.name for item in outcome.report.high_interest}
    for step in outcome.path:
        names.setdefault(step.address, step.name)
    for evidence in tuple(outcome.verdict.evidence):
        label = evidence.description.split(":", 1)[0][:48]
        for text in evidence.addresses:
            try:
                address = int(text, 16)
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                continue
            if address not in seen:
                seen.add(address)
                targets.append((address, names.get(address, "0x{0:X}".format(address)), "evidence: " + label))
    signals = getattr(outcome.code_signals, "functions", ()) or ()
    for item in signals:
        if item.address not in seen:
            seen.add(item.address)
            targets.append((item.address, item.name, "code signals: " + ", ".join(item.kinds)))
    for step in outcome.path:
        if step.address not in seen:
            seen.add(step.address)
            targets.append((step.address, step.name, step.estimated_role))
    for address, name in triage_jump_targets(outcome.report):
        if address not in seen:
            seen.add(address)
            targets.append((address, name, "high interest"))
    return tuple(targets)


def triage_changes(previous: Optional["BinaryTriageOutcome"], current: "BinaryTriageOutcome") -> Tuple[str, ...]:
    """Human-readable differences between two triages of the same file (verdict, evidence, ranking, signals)."""
    if previous is None:
        return ()
    lines: List[str] = []
    before, after = previous.verdict, current.verdict
    if (before.classification, before.subtype, before.score) != (after.classification, after.subtype, after.score):
        lines.append("verdict: {0}{1} {2}/100 → {3}{4} {5}/100".format(
            before.classification, " / " + before.subtype if before.subtype else "", before.score,
            after.classification, " / " + after.subtype if after.subtype else "", after.score))
    old = {item.description for item in before.evidence}
    new = {item.description for item in after.evidence}
    for text in sorted(new - old)[:6]:
        lines.append("+ evidence: " + text[:140])
    for text in sorted(old - new)[:6]:
        lines.append("- evidence: " + text[:140])
    old_top = [item.name for item in previous.report.high_interest[:10]]
    new_top = [item.name for item in current.report.high_interest[:10]]
    entered = [name for name in new_top if name not in old_top]
    if entered:
        lines.append("new in top functions: " + ", ".join(entered[:6]))
    old_signals = {item.address for item in (getattr(previous.code_signals, "functions", ()) or ())}
    new_signals = [item for item in (getattr(current.code_signals, "functions", ()) or ()) if item.address not in old_signals]
    if new_signals:
        lines.append("new code signals in: " + ", ".join(item.name for item in new_signals[:6]))
    return tuple(lines) if lines else ("no change",)


def format_jump_label(index: int, address: int, name: str, role: str) -> str:
    """``N. name [0xADDR] — role`` as shown in the Triage jump list."""
    return "{0}. {1} [0x{2:X}] — {3}".format(index, name, address, role)


def verdict_to_dict(verdict: Verdict) -> dict:
    return {
        "score": verdict.score,
        "band": verdict.band.value,
        "band_label": verdict.band.label,
        "local_band": (verdict.local_band or verdict.band).value,
        "evidence": [item.format() for item in verdict.evidence],
        "mitigating": [item.format() for item in verdict.mitigating],
        "packing_indicators": list(verdict.packing_indicators),
        "library_ratio": verdict.library_ratio,
        "summary": verdict.summary,
        "model_band": verdict.model_band.value if verdict.model_band is not None else None,
        "model_band_label": verdict.model_band.label if verdict.model_band is not None else None,
        "model_rationale": verdict.model_rationale,
        "model_evidence": list(verdict.model_evidence),
        "model_disagreements": list(verdict.model_disagreements),
        "notes": list(verdict.notes),
    }


def analysis_path_to_list(path: Sequence[AnalysisStep]) -> List[dict]:
    return [
        {
            "order": step.order,
            "address": "0x{0:X}".format(step.address),
            "name": step.name,
            "why": step.why,
            "look_for": list(step.look_for),
            "priority": step.priority,
            "estimated_role": step.estimated_role,
            "on_suspicious_flow": step.on_suspicious_flow,
            "score": step.score,
        }
        for step in path
    ]


def call_flows_to_list(flows: Sequence[CallFlow]) -> List[dict]:
    return [
        {
            "target": "0x{0:X}".format(flow.target),
            "target_name": flow.target_name,
            "path": ["{0} [0x{1:X}]".format(name, address) for address, name in flow.path],
            "reasons": list(flow.reasons[:3]),
            "collapsed_noise": flow.collapsed_noise,
            "note": flow.note,
        }
        for flow in flows
    ]


__all__ = [
    "BinaryTriageOutcome",
    "SweepSeed",
    "analysis_path_to_list",
    "binary_triage_jump_targets",
    "call_flows_to_list",
    "format_binary_triage",
    "format_jump_label",
    "verdict_to_dict",
]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data model
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class VerdictEvidence:
    category: str
    weight: int
    description: str
    addresses: Tuple[str, ...] = ()
    basis: str = "observed"

    def format(self) -> str:
        sign = "+" if self.weight > 0 else ""
        text = "[{0}{1}] {2}".format(sign, self.weight, self.description)
        if self.addresses:
            text += " (" + ", ".join(self.addresses) + ")"
        return text


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Verdict:
    score: int
    band: VerdictBand
    evidence: Tuple[VerdictEvidence, ...]
    mitigating: Tuple[VerdictEvidence, ...]
    library_ratio: float
    packing_indicators: Tuple[str, ...]
    summary: str
    local_band: Optional[VerdictBand] = None
    model_band: Optional[VerdictBand] = None
    model_rationale: Optional[str] = None
    model_evidence: Tuple[str, ...] = ()
    model_disagreements: Tuple[str, ...] = ()
    notes: Tuple[str, ...] = ()
    #: MALWARE / PUP/PUA / SUSPICIOUS-INCONCLUSIVE / LEGITIMATE
    classification: str = ""
    #: e.g. "Infostealer + RAT", "Browser hijacker", "Hacktool / C2 implant"
    subtype: str = ""
    #: 0-100 confidence in ``classification`` (not in the numeric score)
    confidence: int = 0
    language: str = "unknown"
    #: compact code-origin table text (author vs library code), may be empty
    origin_summary: str = ""
    author_function_count: int = 0
    total_function_count: int = 0
    #: How ``confidence`` was computed, one factor per line (ends with ``= N%``).
    confidence_factors: Tuple[str, ...] = ()
    #: Known-family marker matches (hints, not verdicts).
    family_hints: Tuple[str, ...] = ()

    @property
    def headline(self) -> str:
        text = "VERDICT: {0} ({1}/100)".format(self.band.label, self.score)
        if self.classification:
            text += " | {0}{1} - confidence {2}%".format(
                self.classification, " / " + self.subtype if self.subtype else "", self.confidence
            )
        return text

    @property
    def raw_score(self) -> int:
        """Unclamped sum of all weights (for transparency in docs/tests)."""
        return sum(item.weight for item in self.evidence) + sum(item.weight for item in self.mitigating)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Signal collection helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _hex(address: int) -> str:
    return "0x{0:X}".format(address)


def _api_universe(overview: BinaryOverview, ranked: Sequence[FunctionScore]) -> Tuple[Set[str], Dict[str, List[int]]]:
    """Normalised API names seen anywhere (IAT, per-function import calls, ranked), plus where they were called."""

def _summary(verdict: Verdict, import_count: int, function_count: int) -> str:
    """One-paragraph conclusion. The evidence itself is listed once, under "Why"; it is not repeated here."""
    behaviours = [item.description.split(":", 1)[0] for item in verdict.evidence if item.category.startswith("behaviour:")]
    capabilities = [item.category for item in verdict.evidence if not item.category.startswith("behaviour:") and item.category not in ("packing", "strings")]
    text = "{0}{1} with {2}% confidence (score {3}/100, {4} aggravating / {5} mitigating signals, {6} of {7} functions are author code).".format(
        verdict.classification or verdict.band.label,
        " / " + verdict.subtype if verdict.subtype else "",
        verdict.confidence,
        verdict.score,
        len(verdict.evidence),
        len(verdict.mitigating),
        verdict.author_function_count,
        function_count,
    )
    if behaviours or capabilities:
        text += " Key behaviour: " + ", ".join(list(dict.fromkeys(behaviours + capabilities))[:5]) + "."
    if verdict.packing_indicators:
        text += " Packing indicators present."
    if not verdict.evidence:
        text += " No indicators were observed; packed or run-time-resolved code is invisible to this pass."
    return text

    return load_prompt(prompt_path, "Verdict prompt")


def verdict_to_payload(verdict: Verdict, report: Optional[TriageReport] = None, max_functions: int = 10) -> dict:
    """Compact evidence summary only: no code, pseudocode or function corpus."""
    functions = []
    if report is not None:
        for item in report.high_interest[:max_functions]:
            functions.append({"address": _hex(item.address), "name": item.name, "score": item.score, "reasons": list(item.reasons)})
    return {
        "local_verdict": {
            "score": verdict.score,
            "band": verdict.band.value,
            "bands": [band.value for band in _BAND_ORDER],
            "library_ratio": verdict.library_ratio,
            "classification": verdict.classification,
            "subtype": verdict.subtype,
            "language": verdict.language,
            "author_functions": verdict.author_function_count,
            "total_functions": verdict.total_function_count,
        },
        "notes": list(verdict.notes),
        "evidence": [item.format() for item in verdict.evidence],
        "mitigating": [item.format() for item in verdict.mitigating],
        "packing_indicators": list(verdict.packing_indicators),
        "top_functions": functions,
        "uncertainties": list(report.uncertainties) if report is not None else [],

"""Readable, deterministic verdict justification (no model call).

One short analyst-style paragraph: what the binary does as a whole, which
findings show it, and why that leads to the classification. Used by the
Binary Triage tab and as the Report's fallback when the model's paragraph is
unavailable. Works on any verdict-like object (duck-typed) so it can be
imported from ``verdict.py`` without a cycle.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import Any, List, Sequence, Tuple

from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis import behaviour as bh

# What each corroborated behaviour means for the binary, phrased as "it ...".
BEHAVIOUR_PHRASES = {
    bh.CREDENTIAL_THEFT: "steals stored credentials and other user data",
    bh.KEYLOGGING: "records keystrokes and clipboard contents",
    bh.SURVEILLANCE: "captures the screen, webcam or microphone",
    bh.REMOTE_CONTROL: "accepts remote commands like a RAT or remote shell",
    bh.C2: "talks to a command-and-control server and sends data out",
    bh.PERSISTENCE: "installs itself to survive a reboot",
    bh.INJECTION: "injects or loads code into memory",
    bh.EVASION: "tries to evade analysis or remove itself",
    bh.PRIVILEGE: "escalates privileges or steals access tokens",
    bh.RANSOMWARE: "encrypts files for ransom",
    bh.DOWNLOAD_EXECUTE: "downloads and runs further payloads",
    bh.CRYPTO_MINING: "mines crypto-currency",
    bh.HACKTOOL: "contains offensive-framework (hacktool) functionality",
    bh.PUP_BROWSER_HIJACK: "changes browser settings",
    bh.PUP_ADWARE: "shows advertising or bundled offers",
    bh.CONFIG_DECODING: "decrypts embedded strings or configuration",
}
_LANGUAGE_NAMES = {"go": "Go", "rust": "Rust", "delphi": "Delphi", "nim": "Nim", "dotnet": ".NET", ".net": ".NET",
                   "c/c++": "C/C++", "cpp": "C/C++", "c": "C"}
_SUPPORTING = " (supporting)"
_FUNCTIONS_RE = re.compile(r"author functions (?P<names>[^·;]+?)(?: \(\+\d+\))?(?: ·|;|$)")
MAX_CHARS = 1400


def _clean(text: Any, limit: int = 160) -> str:
    value = " ".join(str(text if text is not None else "").split())
    return value if len(value) <= limit else value[: limit - 1] + "…"


def _join(items: Sequence[str]) -> str:
    items = [item for item in items if item]
    if len(items) <= 1:
        return "".join(items)
    return ", ".join(items[:-1]) + " and " + items[-1]


def _label(description: str) -> str:
    return description.split(":", 1)[0].replace(_SUPPORTING, "").strip()


def _functions(description: str, limit: int = 2) -> List[str]:
    match = _FUNCTIONS_RE.search(description)
    if not match:
        return []
    names = [name.strip() for name in match.group("names").split(",") if name.strip()]
    # The sample's own entry package reads best; wrappers add nothing.
    names = [name for name in names if not re.search(r"\.(?:deferwrap|gowrap|func)\d+$", name)] or names
    names.sort(key=lambda name: (not name.startswith(("main.", "main_")), names.index(name)))
    return names[:limit]


def _behaviours(verdict: Any) -> Tuple[List[Tuple[str, Any]], List[Tuple[str, Any]]]:
    """``(strong, supporting)`` behaviour evidence as ``(category, item)``, strongest first."""
    strong: List[Tuple[str, Any]] = []
    weak: List[Tuple[str, Any]] = []
    for item in sorted(getattr(verdict, "evidence", ()) or (), key=lambda entry: -entry.weight):
        category = str(item.category)
        if not category.startswith("behaviour:") or item.weight <= 0:
            continue
        (weak if _SUPPORTING in item.description else strong).append((category.split(":", 1)[1], item))
    return strong, weak


def _evidence_clause(category: str, item: Any) -> str:
    names = _functions(item.description)
    where = ", ".join(item.addresses[:1]) if getattr(item, "addresses", ()) else ""
    label = bh.CATEGORY_LABELS.get(category, _label(item.description))
    if names:
        return "{0} ({1}{2})".format(label, ", ".join(names), " at " + where if where else "")
    detail = _label(item.description.split(":", 1)[1]) if ":" in item.description else ""
    return "{0}{1}".format(label, " (" + _clean(detail, 80) + ")" if detail else "")


def verdict_justification(verdict: Any, function_roles: Sequence[str] = ()) -> str:
    """One readable paragraph built only from the verdict's own evidence.

    ``function_roles`` (optional) are one-sentence summaries of analysed author
    functions, used to describe the binary when no behaviour was corroborated.
    """
    classification = getattr(verdict, "classification", "") or "UNDETERMINED"
    subtype = getattr(verdict, "subtype", "") or ""
    confidence = getattr(verdict, "confidence", 0)
    score = getattr(verdict, "score", 0)
    language = str(getattr(verdict, "language", "unknown") or "unknown")
    author = getattr(verdict, "author_function_count", 0)
    total = getattr(verdict, "total_function_count", 0)
    strong, weak = _behaviours(verdict)
    pretty = _LANGUAGE_NAMES.get(language.lower(), language)
    subject = "This {0} binary".format(pretty) if language != "unknown" else "This binary"
    scope = " ({0} of its {1} functions are its own code, the rest is runtime and library code)".format(author, total) if total else ""
    parts: List[str] = []

    # 1. What the binary does as a whole.
    if strong:
        phrases = list(dict.fromkeys(BEHAVIOUR_PHRASES.get(category, bh.CATEGORY_LABELS.get(category, category)) for category, _ in strong))
        parts.append("{0}{1} {2}.".format(subject, scope, _join(phrases[:5])))
    elif function_roles:
        parts.append("{0}{1} mainly {2}.".format(subject, scope, "; ".join(
            role[0].lower() + role[1:] if role[:1].isupper() else role for role in (_clean(r, 140).rstrip(".") for r in function_roles[:3]))))
    else:
        parts.append("{0}{1} shows no corroborated malicious behaviour in its own code.".format(subject, scope))

    # 2. The findings that show it.
    if strong:
        parts.append("This is shown by " + _join([_evidence_clause(category, item) for category, item in strong[:3]]) + ".")
    family = tuple(getattr(verdict, "family_hints", ()) or ())

    # 3. Why this classification.
    rating = "{0}% confidence, score {1}/100".format(confidence, score)
    if classification == "MALWARE":
        kind = " ({0})".format(subtype) if subtype else ""
        parts.append("Because this behaviour is implemented in the sample's own code rather than in a library, it is "
                     "classified as malware{0} ({1}).".format(kind, rating))
    elif classification == "PUP/PUA":
        parts.append("It is classified as a potentially unwanted program{0} ({1}): the behaviour is unwanted, but no credential "
                     "theft, remote control or code injection was corroborated.".format(" (" + subtype + ")" if subtype else "", rating))
    elif classification == "LEGITIMATE":
        parts.append("No credential theft, remote control, injection, persistence, ransomware or covert C2 was corroborated "
                     "in the author code, so it is classified as legitimate ({0}).".format(rating))
    else:
        parts.append("The signals are suspicious but not corroborated enough for a malware verdict, so it is rated "
                     "suspicious / inconclusive ({0}).".format(rating))

    # 4. Caveats: weaker hints, benign signals, family markers, packing.
    if weak:
        parts.append("Weaker, uncorroborated hints: {0}.".format(_join([bh.CATEGORY_LABELS.get(c, _label(i.description)) for c, i in weak[:3]])))
    benign = [_label(item.description) for item in getattr(verdict, "mitigating", ()) or () if item.weight < 0][:2]
    if benign and classification != "LEGITIMATE":
        parts.append("Benign signals considered: {0}.".format(_join(benign)))
    if family:
        parts.append("Marker matches point to {0} (a hint, not proof).".format(_clean(family[0], 80)))
    if getattr(verdict, "packing_indicators", ()):
        parts.append("Packing or obfuscation may hide more code, so dynamic analysis is advised.")
    text = " ".join(parts)
    return text if len(text) <= MAX_CHARS else text[: MAX_CHARS - 1] + "…"


__all__ = ["BEHAVIOUR_PHRASES", "verdict_justification"]

def _behaviours(verdict: Any) -> Tuple[List[Tuple[str, Any]], List[Tuple[str, Any]]]:
    """``(strong, supporting)`` behaviour evidence as ``(category, item)``, strongest first."""
    strong: List[Tuple[str, Any]] = []
    weak: List[Tuple[str, Any]] = []
    for item in sorted(getattr(verdict, "evidence", ()) or (), key=lambda entry: -entry.weight):
        category = str(item.category)
        if not category.startswith("behaviour:") or item.weight <= 0:
            continue
        (weak if _SUPPORTING in item.description else strong).append((category.split(":", 1)[1], item))
    return strong, weak


def _evidence_clause(category: str, item: Any) -> str:
    names = _functions(item.description)
    where = ", ".join(item.addresses[:1]) if getattr(item, "addresses", ()) else ""
    label = bh.CATEGORY_LABELS.get(category, _label(item.description))
    if names:
        return "{0} ({1}{2})".format(label, ", ".join(names), " at " + where if where else "")
    detail = _label(item.description.split(":", 1)[1]) if ":" in item.description else ""
    return "{0}{1}".format(label, " (" + _clean(detail, 80) + ")" if detail else "")

    """One readable paragraph built only from the verdict's own evidence.

    functions, used to describe the binary when no behaviour was corroborated.

    classification = getattr(verdict, "classification", "") or "UNDETERMINED"
    subtype = getattr(verdict, "subtype", "") or ""
    confidence = getattr(verdict, "confidence", 0)
    score = getattr(verdict, "score", 0)
    language = str(getattr(verdict, "language", "unknown") or "unknown")
    author = getattr(verdict, "author_function_count", 0)
    total = getattr(verdict, "total_function_count", 0)
    strong, weak = _behaviours(verdict)
    pretty = _LANGUAGE_NAMES.get(language.lower(), language)
    subject = "This {0} binary".format(pretty) if language != "unknown" else "This binary"
    scope = " ({0} of its {1} functions are its own code, the rest is runtime and library code)".format(author, total) if total else ""
    parts: List[str] = []

    # 1. What the binary does as a whole.
    if strong:
        phrases = list(dict.fromkeys(BEHAVIOUR_PHRASES.get(category, bh.CATEGORY_LABELS.get(category, category)) for category, _ in strong))
        parts.append("{0}{1} {2}.".format(subject, scope, _join(phrases[:5])))
    elif function_roles:
        parts.append("{0}{1} mainly {2}.".format(subject, scope, "; ".join(
            role[0].lower() + role[1:] if role[:1].isupper() else role for role in (_clean(r, 140).rstrip(".") for r in function_roles[:3]))))
    else:
        parts.append("{0}{1} shows no corroborated malicious behaviour in its own code.".format(subject, scope))

    elif classification == "PUP/PUA":
        parts.append("It is classified as a potentially unwanted program{0} ({1}): the behaviour is unwanted, but no credential "
                     "theft, remote control or code injection was corroborated.".format(" (" + subtype + ")" if subtype else "", rating))
    elif classification == "LEGITIMATE":
        parts.append("No credential theft, remote control, injection, persistence, ransomware or covert C2 was corroborated "
                     "in the author code, so it is classified as legitimate ({0}).".format(rating))
    else:
        parts.append("The signals are suspicious but not corroborated enough for a malware verdict, so it is rated "
                     "suspicious / inconclusive ({0}).".format(rating))

    # 4. Caveats: weaker hints, benign signals, family markers, packing.
    if weak:
        parts.append("Weaker, uncorroborated hints: {0}.".format(_join([bh.CATEGORY_LABELS.get(c, _label(i.description)) for c, i in weak[:3]])))
    benign = [_label(item.description) for item in getattr(verdict, "mitigating", ()) or () if item.weight < 0][:2]
    if benign and classification != "LEGITIMATE":
        parts.append("Benign signals considered: {0}.".format(_join(benign)))
    if family:
        parts.append("Marker matches point to {0} (a hint, not proof).".format(_clean(family[0], 80)))
    if getattr(verdict, "packing_indicators", ()):
        parts.append("Packing or obfuscation may hide more code, so dynamic analysis is advised.")
    text = " ".join(parts)

You receive only facts already collected by local analysis and by per-function AI analysis inside IDA Pro: the verdict (classification, subtype, confidence, local score and band), the scored evidence the verdict is built on (positive weights raise suspicion, negative weights are benign signals), the code-origin breakdown (author code versus runtime, standard-library, third-party and compiler code), static PE facts, packing indicators, and the analysed author functions with their summaries and capabilities. """Readable, deterministic verdict justification (no model call).

One short analyst-style paragraph: what the binary does as a whole, which
findings show it, and why that leads to the classification. Used by the
Binary Triage tab and as the Report's fallback when the model's paragraph is
unavailable. Works on any verdict-like object (duck-typed) so it can be
imported from ``verdict.py`` without a cycle.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import Any, List, Sequence, Tuple

from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis import behaviour as bh

# What each corroborated behaviour means for the binary, phrased as "it ...".
BEHAVIOUR_PHRASES = {
    bh.CREDENTIAL_THEFT: "steals stored credentials and other user data",
    bh.KEYLOGGING: "records keystrokes and clipboard contents",
    bh.SURVEILLANCE: "captures the screen, webcam or microphone",
    bh.REMOTE_CONTROL: "accepts remote commands like a RAT or remote shell",
    bh.C2: "talks to a command-and-control server and sends data out",
    bh.PERSISTENCE: "installs itself to survive a reboot",
    bh.INJECTION: "injects or loads code into memory",
    bh.EVASION: "tries to evade analysis or remove itself",
    bh.PRIVILEGE: "escalates privileges or steals access tokens",
    bh.RANSOMWARE: "encrypts files for ransom",
    bh.DOWNLOAD_EXECUTE: "downloads and runs further payloads",
    bh.CRYPTO_MINING: "mines crypto-currency",
    bh.HACKTOOL: "contains offensive-framework (hacktool) functionality",
    bh.PUP_BROWSER_HIJACK: "changes browser settings",
    bh.PUP_ADWARE: "shows advertising or bundled offers",
    bh.CONFIG_DECODING: "decrypts embedded strings or configuration",
}
_LANGUAGE_NAMES = {"go": "Go", "rust": "Rust", "delphi": "Delphi", "nim": "Nim", "dotnet": ".NET", ".net": ".NET",
                   "c/c++": "C/C++", "cpp": "C/C++", "c": "C"}
_SUPPORTING = " (supporting)"
_FUNCTIONS_RE = re.compile(r"author functions (?P<names>[^·;]+?)(?: \(\+\d+\))?(?: ·|;|$)")
MAX_CHARS = 1400


def _clean(text: Any, limit: int = 160) -> str:
    value = " ".join(str(text if text is not None else "").split())
    return value if len(value) <= limit else value[: limit - 1] + "…"


def _join(items: Sequence[str]) -> str:
    items = [item for item in items if item]
    if len(items) <= 1:
        return "".join(items)
    return ", ".join(items[:-1]) + " and " + items[-1]


def _label(description: str) -> str:
    return description.split(":", 1)[0].replace(_SUPPORTING, "").strip()


def _functions(description: str, limit: int = 2) -> List[str]:
    match = _FUNCTIONS_RE.search(description)
    if not match:
        return []
    names = [name.strip() for name in match.group("names").split(",") if name.strip()]
    # The sample's own entry package reads best; wrappers add nothing.
    names = [name for name in names if not re.search(r"\.(?:deferwrap|gowrap|func)\d+$", name)] or names
    names.sort(key=lambda name: (not name.startswith(("main.", "main_")), names.index(name)))
    return names[:limit]


def _behaviours(verdict: Any) -> Tuple[List[Tuple[str, Any]], List[Tuple[str, Any]]]:
    """``(strong, supporting)`` behaviour evidence as ``(category, item)``, strongest first."""
    strong: List[Tuple[str, Any]] = []
    weak: List[Tuple[str, Any]] = []
    for item in sorted(getattr(verdict, "evidence", ()) or (), key=lambda entry: -entry.weight):
        category = str(item.category)
        if not category.startswith("behaviour:") or item.weight <= 0:
            continue
        (weak if _SUPPORTING in item.description else strong).append((category.split(":", 1)[1], item))
    return strong, weak


def _evidence_clause(category: str, item: Any) -> str:
    names = _functions(item.description)
    where = ", ".join(item.addresses[:1]) if getattr(item, "addresses", ()) else ""
    label = bh.CATEGORY_LABELS.get(category, _label(item.description))
    if names:
        return "{0} ({1}{2})".format(label, ", ".join(names), " at " + where if where else "")
    detail = _label(item.description.split(":", 1)[1]) if ":" in item.description else ""
    return "{0}{1}".format(label, " (" + _clean(detail, 80) + ")" if detail else "")


def verdict_justification(verdict: Any, function_roles: Sequence[str] = ()) -> str:
    """One readable paragraph built only from the verdict's own evidence.

    ``function_roles`` (optional) are one-sentence summaries of analysed author
    functions, used to describe the binary when no behaviour was corroborated.
    """
    classification = getattr(verdict, "classification", "") or "UNDETERMINED"
    subtype = getattr(verdict, "subtype", "") or ""
    confidence = getattr(verdict, "confidence", 0)
    score = getattr(verdict, "score", 0)
    language = str(getattr(verdict, "language", "unknown") or "unknown")
    author = getattr(verdict, "author_function_count", 0)
    total = getattr(verdict, "total_function_count", 0)
    strong, weak = _behaviours(verdict)
    pretty = _LANGUAGE_NAMES.get(language.lower(), language)
    subject = "This {0} binary".format(pretty) if language != "unknown" else "This binary"
    scope = " ({0} of its {1} functions are its own code, the rest is runtime and library code)".format(author, total) if total else ""
    parts: List[str] = []

    # 1. What the binary does as a whole.
    if strong:
        phrases = list(dict.fromkeys(BEHAVIOUR_PHRASES.get(category, bh.CATEGORY_LABELS.get(category, category)) for category, _ in strong))
        parts.append("{0}{1} {2}.".format(subject, scope, _join(phrases[:5])))
    elif function_roles:
        parts.append("{0}{1} mainly {2}.".format(subject, scope, "; ".join(
            role[0].lower() + role[1:] if role[:1].isupper() else role for role in (_clean(r, 140).rstrip(".") for r in function_roles[:3]))))
    else:
        parts.append("{0}{1} shows no corroborated malicious behaviour in its own code.".format(subject, scope))

    # 2. The findings that show it.
    if strong:
        parts.append("This is shown by " + _join([_evidence_clause(category, item) for category, item in strong[:3]]) + ".")
    family = tuple(getattr(verdict, "family_hints", ()) or ())

    # 3. Why this classification.
    rating = "{0}% confidence, score {1}/100".format(confidence, score)
    if classification == "MALWARE":
        kind = " ({0})".format(subtype) if subtype else ""
        parts.append("Because this behaviour is implemented in the sample's own code rather than in a library, it is "
                     "classified as malware{0} ({1}).".format(kind, rating))
    elif classification == "PUP/PUA":
        parts.append("It is classified as a potentially unwanted program{0} ({1}): the behaviour is unwanted, but no credential "
                     "theft, remote control or code injection was corroborated.".format(" (" + subtype + ")" if subtype else "", rating))
    elif classification == "LEGITIMATE":
        parts.append("No credential theft, remote control, injection, persistence, ransomware or covert C2 was corroborated "
                     "in the author code, so it is classified as legitimate ({0}).".format(rating))
    else:
        parts.append("The signals are suspicious but not corroborated enough for a malware verdict, so it is rated "
                     "suspicious / inconclusive ({0}).".format(rating))

    # 4. Caveats: weaker hints, benign signals, family markers, packing.
    if weak:
        parts.append("Weaker, uncorroborated hints: {0}.".format(_join([bh.CATEGORY_LABELS.get(c, _label(i.description)) for c, i in weak[:3]])))
    benign = [_label(item.description) for item in getattr(verdict, "mitigating", ()) or () if item.weight < 0][:2]
    if benign and classification != "LEGITIMATE":
        parts.append("Benign signals considered: {0}.".format(_join(benign)))
    if family:
        parts.append("Marker matches point to {0} (a hint, not proof).".format(_clean(family[0], 80)))
    if getattr(verdict, "packing_indicators", ()):
        parts.append("Packing or obfuscation may hide more code, so dynamic analysis is advised.")
    text = " ".join(parts)
    return text if len(text) <= MAX_CHARS else text[: MAX_CHARS - 1] + "…"


__all__ = ["BEHAVIOUR_PHRASES", "verdict_justification"]
